pyqgis_plugin.name: Plan Stages
pyqgis_plugin.description: Stage-by-stage fibre planning with operator approval after every stage.
pyqgis_plugin.changelog: 0.15.1 Delivery fixes: the delivered QGIS project now includes the Poles layer (feeder and distribution poles coloured), which was left out when the poles were stored in the site's metre-based CRS; on QGIS 3 the Delivery stage no longer fails after it has finished (QGIS 3 crashed while closing down the helper that builds the project and the map images); a layer from another site is now refused even when it is a single point; 0.15.0 Update pop-up: each time you open the Plan Stages panel and a newer version is out, a pop-up says so and lists what is new; Update installs it (offering to Save an unsaved site first), Skip for now closes it until the next time you open the panel. From this version on, every update announces itself; 0.14.0 Choosing a client spec loads it ready to plan: every value from the client's documents comes in already accepted (untick or retype any you disagree with), and a drop cap, span cap or cross-span cap the client does not state takes HeroTel's value (70, 70, 40 m), marked "HeroTel value used"; density and the split ratios still come only from the client's documents, and documents that disagree still ask you to pick. The feeder stays inside the AOI: with an AOI in the wayleave, P1 routes only on the roads inside it (Kingsway's feeder had taken a road 1.2 km outside the site); 0.13.0 P6 Pole reconciliation is removed: it added poles where there should be none, while your wayleave already has its poles. The poles layer is now required in the wayleave and is used exactly as you drew it; nothing adds or moves a pole. Splitters and dome joints (now P6) hang on your wayleave poles, and Delivery (now P7) ships them. P2's Check warns on a 1:16 with none of your poles within 2 m, and P4's Check tells you to draw the missing pole in the wayleave. Opening a site from 0.12.0: the old P6 is left out (its files stay on disk), and Splitters and dome joints and Delivery are marked stale; Generate them again. Spec details ticked at the old P6 are asked at P4. The pole heights move from the planning values to the other values on the Spec tab: no stage uses them now, and they no longer have to be filled before planning; 0.12.0 Works on QGIS 3 (3.40 or later) as well as QGIS 4: one install for both, from the same repository address; the helper scripts find whichever QGIS is installed (QGIS LTR's qgis-ltr folder, Qt5 or Qt6), the P8 project is written with that QGIS, not a fixed QGIS 4.2.0 path; on QGIS 3 the spec PDF page opens in your PDF viewer; the download is now named plan_stages.<version>.zip so QGIS recognises the installed plugin and offers updates under Upgradeable; 0.11.1 The distribution follows the span where a stretch of it is drawn twice: two span features lying on top of each other no longer collapse into one point with straight lines drawn from it across the yards (Frankfort had 32 such places, up to 91 m); Gate 0, P1 and P3 now keep those stretches on the span, and Gate 0's dropped-sliver metres fall to the doubled copy only; 0.11.0 Plan P1 in three stages, so you correct each before the next is built on it: P1 Feeder (from the POP to every PON; Check adds an error for a PON the feeder does not reach), P2 1:16 splitters (one per PON on your approved feeder, where P1 aimed it if the feeder still passes there, otherwise on the feeder point nearest that PON's span; a PON the feeder does not reach gets none and its Why window says why) and P3 Distribution (the span split per PON; a 1:16 you moved off the span gets one straight link to its PON's span, and Check wants every 1:16 to join the distribution); the later stages are now P4 Collection points and drops, P5 Road crossings, P6 Pole reconciliation, P7 Splitters and dome joints and P8 Delivery; A site made before 0.11.0 opens with its wayleave, Gate 0 and spec kept and every plan stage starts again from P1, its old plan work moved to the site's old-layout folder (nothing is deleted); The feeder now runs beside the road (2 m inside the property line, or 6.5 m off the road line), keeps off paths through properties, and a crossing ends once the cable is off the road; P1 no longer stops on an erf whose outline crosses itself; 0.10.0 Nothing stops you starting: Gate 0 no longer fails on the span (in pieces, the POP off it, a PON with no span or not reachable are warnings; P1 plans on the span as drawn), and Use this wayleave saves the Spec tab's sheet for you when no revision is saved yet; Fewer layers to read: road crossings are Drill or Trench only (up to 30 m is Drill, longer is Trench; no Escalate), the poles layers have one symbol, and P4 lists only the poles the plan uses (unused wayleave poles stay in the wayleave); Click a PON with no 1:16 and a Why window says why P1 left it out (its streets are not joined to the POP's roads, or the 1:16 is no longer inside the PON or on its edge) and what to fix; P6 Delivery runs (its two scripts were missing from the plugin); Remove on one gap of a line removes only that gap; 0.9.0 Client spec dropdown on the Spec tab and in New site: HeroTel, Vuma Reach/Core/Key, Fibertime Informal/Formal, MetroFibre; every value with its document, page and sentence, for you to tick; adding the client's PDF checks the quotes (a renamed PDF: the message names the documents the preset quotes); the dropdown changes only when clicked, never by scrolling the panel, and asks before replacing a saved sheet; Copy from or Find in PDFs after a preset saves no preset; 0.8.1 Gate 0 takes your wayleave as drawn: far demand points, poles off the span and overlapping span features are information in the check log, not issues; your fixes stay crossed out: an issue the Check still finds on a feature you edited is listed as "fixed by you" and does not come back; Remove issue: a warning or an error you judge is not a real problem stays removed through every Check and every new Generate, recorded at Approve (a failed check whose issues are all removed no longer stops Approve); a removal covers only that issue: other issues on the same feature, and any new one, stay on the list; the Wayleave box rows no longer change when you scroll the panel over them (click a row first to use the mouse wheel in it) and never offer the plugin's own issue or stage layers; 0.8.0 P2 follows your corrected P1 cable: collection points only on wayleave poles on your cable, poles your cable left behind are not used, and where no pole is near the point stands on the cable and the Check says P4 will propose a pole there (new field on_pole); 0.7.0 Every step builds on what you corrected: checks work from what is drawn (fan cap from your drops, road-crossing drops warned, collection points off your P1 cable warned, 1:16 by the PON it stands in, hand-drawn collection points numbered at Check); P4 puts a feeder pole on every 1:16; P5 hangs splitters and domes on your P4 poles; Generate stops when the wayleave on screen differs from the snapshot; 0.6.2 Your own details on the Spec tab (Add a detail…, tagged to the stages they affect, kept through Find in PDFs and Copy from); a stage with your details is approved only once you tick each one as checked against the plan (recorded in approval.json); up to 100 extra details from the PDFs, rules without numbers included; 0.6.1 Help page brought up to date with Find in PDFs (no key needed; it replaces the sheet, so read the PDFs first; worked-out caps; extras as written); 0.6.0 Find in PDFs: the planning values found in the spec PDFs with no API key (HeroTel's documents taught), type the density to settle the splitter ratios, type anything not stated; 0.5.0 Extra details from the submitted spec PDFs (other values, cable, stays, clearances, labelling...) in their own block with read ticks, never blocking Save revision; 0.4.0 Spec PDFs checked: every statement of each planning value listed, each quote checked against the PDF, documents that disagree flagged for you to pick, the source page shown with the sentence highlighted, and a Ready to plan line; 0.3.1 Help tab: what you need before using the plugin, the wayleave layers and fields, setting up a site, and what to do when something is greyed out (opens the first time); 0.3.0 rollout: Copy spec from a HeroTel template or another site, Lo-zone CRS suggestion, optional building footprints row, PONs over the cap warn, PON rows click to the right PON; 0.2.0 clickable issues, self-contained bundle; 0.1.0 first operator walk
